topic: Assessment of damage and estimation of loads, preparation of repair scheme.
syllabus_extract: Assessment of damage and estimation of loads, preparation of repair scheme. Material specification, special tools required for carrying out repairs
specific_objectives: 11.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain aircraft structure, various structural elements and their details.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of damage assessment techniques, load estimation calculations, and repair scheme preparation using standard tools and material specifications under instructor supervision.
intro_questions: What are the primary steps in assessing aircraft structural damage?
How do you determine the load type acting on a damaged structural element?
Why is material specification critical before initiating a repair scheme?

development.content:
Visual inspection for damage types
Non-destructive testing methods
Load estimation principles
Material specification selection
Special tools identification

Damage assessment procedures
Load calculation formulas
Repair scheme formulation
Tool selection criteria
Material compatibility checks

Review of repair documentation
Safety precautions for repairs
Final scheme validation
Tool maintenance protocols
Material storage guidelines

summary_questions: Explain the relationship between load estimation and repair scheme design.
List three special tools required for carrying out structural repairs.
Describe the importance of material specification in damage repair.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the transition from damage assessment to repair scheme preparation for the next lesson plan (LP 02).
